==About==

Crafting {{i|Rye Bread}} at a {{i|Baking Table}} will make {{i|Unleavened Ryebread Dough}} which can then be left to rest inside the Baking Table until it becomes {{i|Leavened Ryebread Dough}}. Leavened Ryebread Dough, when baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}}, will produce Rye Bread. Preparing Foods on a Baking Table removes a small amount of [[Insanity]] and has a chance of giving you an {{i|Eloped Gingerbread Man}}. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
